facts.fact: Africa Data Protection reports that a decree of 8 June 2026 abolished Niger's Haute Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (HAPDP), that an ordonnance of the same day repealed the 2022 law's provisions founding it, and that its tasks pass to the Justice and Interior ministries.
